name: IndependenceConfirmationTracker
tagline: Annual independence & ethics confirmations, restricted-list matching and exception remediation – one drop-in Power Apps app.
description: A complete independence and ethics confirmation module for audit, tax, advisory and law firms. Request annual, new-joiner, promotion and engagement-specific confirmations, collect Yes/No declarations and holdings with attestation, match holdings against the firm's restricted entity list, raise exceptions automatically, remediate and resolve them, and clear each person with segregation of duties – in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Demo mode with fictional firm data
Holdings matched to the restricted entity list (Prohibited / Pre-clearance / Monitored)
Automatic exceptions with severity and remediation due dates
Clearing rules and segregation of duties
Self-service, ethics team and viewer roles
Completion KPIs by practice and grade
Power Fx outputs and six events
Optional Dataverse / Power Pages Web API save
controlType: standard (2 controls: IndependenceConfirmationTracker data-set + IndependenceConfirmationTrackerPortal field)
